mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user WHERE user_id = #{user_id}
SELECT user_code, user_id, user_name, user_dept, user_position, use_yn, admin_yn, reg_date FROM tb_user ORDER BY user_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user (user_id, user_pwd, user_name, user_dept, user_position, use_yn, admin_yn) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{user_pwd}, #{user_name}, #{user_dept}, #{user_position}, #{use_yn}, #{admin_yn})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET user_name = #{user_name}, user_dept = #{user_dept}, user_position = #{user_position}, use_yn = #{use_yn}, admin_yn = #{admin_yn} WHERE user_code = #{user_code}
UPDATE tb_user SET user_pwd = #{user_pwd} WHERE user_code = #{user_code}
